title: 第673章 人家还小要温柔点第672章 马甲暴露了
slug: 人在废丹房我以丹药证道成仙
content_zh:
随着记忆的回溯，时间来到前两日。
苍龙帝国，某处荒原之上。
叶云，苍月，以及帝国太上长老古陀相视而立。
而他们的话题，也只围绕着一件事，那就是叶云以及南宫的马甲。
叶云并未承认，皱了下眉头道。
“就凭你说的那些，就说我是南宫前辈？不觉得牵强了一点？”
闻言，太上长老古陀不为所动。
他凝望着叶云，缓缓说道。
“力量可以借用，乃至透支，亦或者用了某种特殊的手段。”
“但你方才所展现出的剑术造诣，却是达到连老夫都惊叹的高度。”
“你说自己是古道圣地的一介供奉长老，觉得能说得过去吗？”
这一番解释，让叶云沉默了下。
他没想到，刚才在苍月那里蒙混过去的点，被再度提了出来。
在其脑海之中，南宫九天倒是乐得看到这一幕，打趣的笑道。
“小子，你还是承认吧，这种事你不可能糊弄的过去。”
实力，乃至力量，都可以说是借用外力。
但是战斗技巧，拥有就是拥有，没有就是没有，无法借用或者透支。
叶云眉头微皱，看了眼前方的古陀缓缓道。
“不错，我就是。”
得到他的肯定，一旁的苍月最先震撼了。

“夫君，您真的是……南宫前辈？”
“没错，不过此事说来话长，以后再给你解释。”
苍月点了下头，神色复杂。
“嗯……”
在这之前，她也是跟那位南宫前辈接触过几次。
可没想到，跟这位叶云居然是同一个人……
得到叶云肯定的答复，古陀倒是不太意外。
他意料之中的点了下头，对其行了一礼。
“那就重新打个招呼，在下古陀，见过南宫道友。”
若是以叶云的身份，他确实可以自诩为前辈。
但要是那位苍蓝口中的南宫，就足以让他同辈相交了。
叶云望着他，淡淡道。
“先不说这个，以我看来，现在最重要的是你们陛下背刺我的事情。”
说到这里，他眼中闪过一道厉芒。
哪怕是面对帝阶强者，这会的他也不卑不亢的质问道。
“你可知道，这次我损失了什么？”
闻听此话，古陀平静的点了下头。
“当然，此事之后，我们苍龙帝国一定给予道友补偿。”
“补偿？”
叶云冷笑一声，将一团破碎的玉简拿了出来，展现在古陀的面前。

“其余的可以补偿，那这卷轴呢？难道，你们还能复刻一个出来？”
这破碎的卷轴，正是金琉璃的传送卷轴。
content_en:
As the memory goes back, time comes to the past two days.
Canglong Empire, somewhere in the wasteland.
Ye Yun, Cang Yue, and the Imperial Supreme Elder Gu Tuo stood looking at each other.
And their topic only revolved around one thing, that was Ye Yun and Nangong's vest.
Ye Yun did not admit it and frowned.
"Based on what you said, do you think I am Senior Nangong? Don't you think it's a bit far-fetched?"
Hearing this, the Supreme Elder Gu Tuo was unmoved.
He stared at Ye Yun and said slowly.
"Power can be borrowed, even overdrawn, or some special means used."
"But the swordsmanship you just showed has reached a level that even me is amazed by."
"You said that you are an elder who worships the ancient holy land. Do you think it's fair to say that?"
This explanation made Ye Yun silent for a moment.
He didn't expect that the point he had just confused with Cang Yue would be brought up again.
In his mind, Nangong Jiutian was happy to see this scene and said with a joking smile.
"Boy, you'd better admit it, you can't get away with this kind of thing."
Strength, and even strength, can be said to be borrowed from external forces.
But combat skills, if you have them, you have them, if you don’t have them, you don’t have them. They cannot be borrowed or overdrawn.
Ye Yun frowned slightly, looked at Gu Tuo in front of him and said slowly.
"Yes, I am."
After receiving his affirmation, Cang Yue was the first to be shocked.
"Husband, are you really...Senior Nangong?"
"That's right, but it's a long story. I'll explain it to you later."
Cang Yue nodded, with a complicated expression.
"Well..."
Before this, she also had contact with senior Nangong several times.
Unexpectedly, he and Ye Yun are actually the same person...
Gu Tuo was not too surprised to receive Ye Yun's affirmative reply.
He nodded as expected and saluted him.
"Then let me say hello again. I met fellow Taoist Nangong in Xiagutuo."
If it were Ye Yun's identity, he could indeed call himself a senior.
But if the Nangong that Canglan talks about is enough to make him acquainted with his peers.
Ye Yun looked at him and said calmly.
"Let's not talk about this first. In my opinion, the most important thing now is your Majesty's backstabbing of me."
When he said this, a sharp light flashed in his eyes.
Even when facing an emperor-level powerhouse, he still asked questions without being humble or arrogant.
"Do you know what I lost this time?"
After hearing this, Gu Tuo nodded calmly.
"Of course, after this incident, our Canglong Empire will definitely compensate our fellow Taoist."
"Compensation?"
Ye Yun sneered, took out a group of broken jade slips, and displayed them in front of Gu Tuo.
"The rest can be compensated, but what about this scroll? Can you still make a replica?"
This broken scroll is Jin Liuli's teleportation scroll.
